name: TwinLevel
title: Copy an angle somewhere else.
short: Match the tilt of two surfaces
full: Capture the tilt of a surface in degrees, move, and match it on this phone or another phone in the room. A local zero can set the current pose to 0°. The under-1° indicator is a display threshold, not a certified measurement.
screenshotNote: Aucune capture réelle d’écran n’a été faite sur un téléphone. Ne pas publier de maquettes à la place.
